IYH Brand Kit · v1.0 · Issue 001 era
Sydney, AU · 14.10.2026

In Your House makes eyewear. We release it in issues, each one documented like a magazine. The first is Issue 001 and the Tripoli frame.

This kit collects what the brand already does across the current site, the Drive folders and the logo files, so the new theme and anything after it can match.

Logo
Desktop · Mobile · Icon

Three logos, one system

The IYH monogram is the desktop logo: the I, Y and H interlocked in soft, swollen serif letters. The wordmark spells the name out in lowercase and ends in the tilted exclamation mark. The mark is that exclamation mark on its own, for spaces too small for either.

Monogram · primary

Desktop header and homepage enter screen. The master artwork is cream on black. Set it 180px wide on the homepage and 80px in page headers.

Monogram on white

The version the theme uses on its white pages. Keep the thin gaps between the letters open.

Wordmark

Mobile header, packaging, social posts, anywhere the name needs spelling out. 150px wide on phones.

Reversed wordmark

On ink, on photography darker than mid-grey, in video end cards.

Mark

Mobile header when space is tight, favicon, app icon, Instagram avatar.

Mark, reversed

Default for icons and avatars. A white mark on an ink square reads best at 16px.

Desktop vs mobile

Monogram on desktop, wordmark at 150px wide on phones. If a header has less than 120px free, use the mark at 28px tall.

Clear space

Around the monogram, leave a quarter of its width on every side. Around the wordmark, leave the height of the exclamation mark's dot.

Minimum size

Monogram at 48px wide on screen, 12mm in print. Wordmark at 96px, 25mm. Mark at 16px, 4mm.

Don't rotate the wordmark. Only the exclamation mark tilts.

Don't recolour it. Ink, cream or white only.

Don't stretch or squash it.

IN YOUR HOUSE!

Don't retype it. Always use the logo files.

Colour
Monochrome

Black, white and the product

The palette is monochrome, so the frames and the photography carry all the colour. Use near-black, not pure black, for anything you can click. Tap a value to copy it.

Buttons, nav hover, announcement bar, icons.

The monogram's colour on black. Use it for the logo only.

Page background, product photo backdrop.

Dividers, sold-out states, input borders.

Rough split on any page
Type
Neue Haas

One family, two weights

Everything is set in Neue Haas Grotesk, the original Helvetica drawing: Display Medium for headings and controls, Text Roman for reading and for small labels. The current site also used VCR OSD Mono for labels. It's been dropped, so the type sits quietly next to the two logos. If the brand fonts fail to load, Helvetica Neue takes over.

Voice
Tone of voice

A press release written by your funniest housemate

IYH copy borrows the structure of a magazine or a lab report, then undercuts it. The long version is deadpan, specific and a little bit filthy. The short version is plain, upper case and gets out of the way.

“Only real housemates are gonna last. All that other bullshit is here today and gone tomorrow.”

Long form · editorial, product story

“Informal testing across multiple jurisdictions only made the evidence more persuasive.”

Our sunglasses have been extensively tested for quality.

Short form · UI, buttons, banners

SIGN UP FOR FUTURE RELEASES

Join our amazing community today!

Specific beats general

“A heavy rectangular silhouette built around exaggerated temples and a low-set lens opening.”

A bold, stylish frame for everyday wear.

Service copy stays straight

Free shipping Australia-wide. 30-day returns.

Shipping's on us, babe!

IssueA release. Numbered with three digits: Issue 001.
BatchA production run or drop. Written BATCH_00.
HousematesCustomers and community, as in "only real housemates are gonna last".
TripoliThe first frame, released in Issue 001.
in your house!The logo spelling. In running copy, write In Your House or IYH.
The HouseThe brand as a place: "a house away from home".
Imagery
Product + campaign

Two kinds of picture

Product shots are clinical. Campaign shots are loose, on location and full of people. Keep them separate, and don't make a product shot look like a campaign shot.

Product pass · front · open
Product pass · front · folded
  • ProductPure white sweep, frame dead centre and front on, soft contact shadow only, 4:5 crop. Same angle set for every frame: front, folded, three-quarter, side and the What's Included shot.
  • CampaignShot on location under hard signage light, like the Kings Cross Coca-Cola sign shoot. Movement, big expressions, models walking and talking to camera.
  • Styling2000s/2010s rap-era streetwear: white singlets, vintage and cropped tees, baggy camo, low-rise denim, denim on denim, big silver hoops, studded belts, fur-hood jackets.
  • VideoVertical 9:16 reels of the frames being worn. Captions in Neue Haas caps, logo end card on ink.
Product detail
Spec format

Write measurements the way opticians do

List frame sizes as lens width, bridge, then temple length, in millimetres. That's the standard optical format customers can compare against frames they already own.

Lens width55mm
Bridge17mm
Temple145mm

TRIPOLI · 55□17 145 · CAT 3 · UV400

To confirm
Found on the site

Inconsistencies to fix

The current site says some things in more than one way. Pick one version of each and use it everywhere.

Warranty

The homepage trust strip says 6-month warranty. The product page says 12-month warranty.

Shipping

The site uses three versions: "Free shipping Australia-wide" in the announcement bar, "Free domestic shipping" on the homepage and "Free AU shipping" on the product page. The kit uses "Free shipping Australia-wide".

Product FAQ

The fit guide, What's Included and FAQ answers on the product page still contain placeholder text such as "Add your confirmed fit guidance here".
